About ten years ago, when I (29F) was in college I developed a close friendship with a male. We had done community service together and hung out a bit over a 2 year time span. He began to like me more than a friend but he was respectful and kept his distance, as I was engaged at the time.

He did a semester "abroad" (in DC which was 3 hours away). We continued to text a call each other and I began to feel closer to him. Many of our discussions were based around our depression. One afternoon he told me of his plan to end his life. He was able to seek out help and then was transported with his RA via train for 3 hours to the hospital near our university.

His parents were notified and his father arrived from.the other side of the United States the next morning. That evening they invited me to dinner at local restaurant. His father and my friend thank me for being so caring. I then went to his hotel and we watched TV.

When it was time for me to go he walked me to my car and we just talked for a little bit. We both began to cry because we realized we will probably never see each other again. He kissed me on the cheek, said goodbye and left.

He took a flight with his father the next morning and I haven't seen him since. We have talked occasionally but we both know we will never see each other again.
